diagnosis.what_happened: Table variable columns were populated with verbose instrument identifiers (e.g. 'سیاهه خودآسیبی سانسون', 'پرسشنامه افسردگی کواکس') instead of pure construct names.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Failing to decouple measurement tools from latent constructs led to methodology labels bleeding into empirical findings tables, cluttering table layouts and violating academic reporting minimalism.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Chapter 4 statistical tables must report pure conceptual variable names ('خودآسیبی', 'رفتارهای خودکشی', 'افسردگی', 'اضطراب', 'نگرانی از تصویر بدنی') without operational nouns ('پرسشنامه', 'سیاهه', 'مقیاس') or author surnames.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Measurement instruments are defined in Chapter 3; reiterating them in Chapter 4 statistical tables reduces data-ink ratio and introduces redundant textual noise.

desired_behavior: Sanitize all variable names in empirical tables to ensure they represent pure conceptual constructs.
generalization: Construct Purity Invariant for all academic empirical tables.
